problemSigns.detail: Your garage door makes excessive noise as it moves up or down. This often indicates worn bearings or flat spots on the rollers.
The garage door moves unevenly or shakes within its tracks. This can mean rollers are not turning smoothly or are misaligned.
Rollers appear flattened on one side or wobble excessively when the door operates. This reduces smooth movement.
The metal shaft connecting the roller to the hinge shows signs of rust, corrosion, or appears bent. Chicago weather can accelerate this.

faqs.q: How do Chicago winters affect garage door rollers in Downers Grove?
faqs.a: Chicago winters are tough on garage door rollers. The extreme cold can make steel rollers brittle. Moisture leads to rust on roller stems and bearings, especially if lubrication is neglected. Road salt tracked into garages can also accelerate corrosion. These conditions cause rollers to seize, flat-spot, or develop loud grinding noises. This stress impacts rollers in both the older detached garages near Downtown Downers and the newer insulated doors in Denburn Woods. Regular maintenance helps, but replacement is necessary when damage occurs.
